name: Ruhe Nagi Streit
source:
Race: Human, unknown heritage
Zodiac sign: Scorpio
Weapon: Sword

Nagi is a swordsman on the Wing Sword. He is the main fighter on the ship, weilding a huge sword and at times, an immense, berseker-like destructive power. When Barn first comes aboard the Wing Sword, Nagi helps train him in swordfighting, and he and Blood immediately form a disliking of each other. He is a self-righteous and stubborn person.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/seikai/seikai.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
